en_how: A Three.js 3D terrain mesh extruded from real AWS SRTM elevation data of the Panama Canal isthmus, textured with satellite imagery under low sun lighting and depth-shaded ocean; camera dives from a 3D globe into the glowing canal route, slices open a 0-to-26-meter lock elevation cross-section with rising 3D pillars, and pulls back out with 2D Chinese landmark callouts and Kokoro narration.
